comparison.objective: Refit and retain a mixer beater and guard, raise the bowl, then verify powered start/stop; candidate separates loose media from washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Bayonet insertion, guard placement, lever/button operation, and powered-equipment clearance versus bimanual screen lifting, load sharing, controlled agitation, and selective aperture passage.
comparison.success_condition: Beater/guard retention, raised bowl, prescribed rotation, stopped mechanism, and clear hands versus ≥98% media recovery, total washer retention, supported screen, release, and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual equipment handling, but they test different mechanisms and outcomes. Missing rubric details: none material.
